mentions.name: Folk computer
mentions.description: Folk computer is an open project building a physical medium for computing, where printed programs are tracked by the computer and enable spatial interaction. Version 2 is in development around a datalog-like engine written in C.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been contributing to a project called Folk computer[1]. It's focused on creating a physical medium for computing (think printing out a program, which is then tracked by the computer. There's some really cool spatial interaction that happens).
